source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 3 (PDF 37-48), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Object Oriented Programming Using Python) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 According to the chapter introduction, polymorphism is studied in order to create:
(Chapter ke introduction ke mutabiq polymorphism kis liye parha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Introduction kehta hai ke polymorphism lachakdar (flexible) aur dhal jane wale (adaptable) programs banane ke liye parha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Students will also study polymorphism to create flexible, adaptable programs.

blocks.prompt:
2 Object-Oriented Programming is a method of designing programs using:
(Object-Oriented Programming programs design karne ka woh tareeqa hai jo kis cheez ko istemal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: OOP objects aur classes ke zariye programs design karne ka tareeqa hai.

book_ref.quote: Object-Oriented Programming is a method of designing programs using objects and classes.

blocks.prompt:
3 In OOP, each object represents:
(OOP mein har object kis cheez ki numaindagi karta hai?)

options.text: haqeeqi duniya ki cheez jis ki khaas properties aur behaviors hon

blocks.explanation: Har object haqeeqi duniya ki aik cheez (entity) hai jis ki khaas properties aur behaviors hain.

book_ref.quote: Each object represents a real-world entity with specific properties and behaviors.

blocks.prompt:
4 Which of the following acts as a template for creating many objects with similar characteristics?
(In mein se kaun si cheez milti julti khoobiyon wale bohat se objects banane ka template hai?)
blocks.explanation: Classes milti julti khoobiyon wale kai objects banane ke liye template (saancha) hain.

book_ref.quote: Classes act as templates for creating multiple objects with similar characteristics.

blocks.prompt:
5 Which of the following is NOT one of the three ideas OOP emphasizes to manage data and behavior?
(In mein se kaun si cheez un teen tasawwurat mein NAHIN jin par OOP zor deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: OOP encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism par zor deta hai.

book_ref.quote: OOP emphasizes encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism to manage data and behavior efficiently.

blocks.prompt:
6 The benefit of OOP by which code is divided into modules so that it is easier to manage is:
(OOP ka woh faida jis mein code ko modules mein baant kar sambhalna aasan hota hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: OOP code ko modules mein baant'ta hai jis se sambhalna aasan hota hai; isi ko modularity kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: OOP allows code to be divided into modules, making it easier to manage.

blocks.prompt:
7 Using the same classes and objects in several programs, so that repetition is reduced, is called:
(Aik hi classes aur objects ko kai programs mein istemal kar ke takrar kam karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Classes aur objects ko kai programs mein dobara istemal kiya ja sakta hai, jis se takrar kam hoti hai (reusability).

book_ref.quote: Classes and objects can be reused in multiple programs or parts of a program, reducing repetition.

blocks.prompt:
8 Programs built with OOP are easier to maintain and update because:
(OOP se bane programs ko maintain aur update karna aasan kyun hota hai?)

options.text: inhein kabhi tabdeeli ki zaroorat nahin hoti
aik hisse ki tabdeeli poore system par asar nahin karti
har tabdeeli poora program dobara likhwati hai

blocks.explanation: OOP programs maintain karna aasan hai kyunke aik hisse ki tabdeeli poore system par asar nahin karti.

book_ref.quote: because changes in one part do not affect the entire system

blocks.prompt:
9 The structure of OOP supports which two qualities in software development?
(OOP ka dhancha software development mein kin do khoobiyon ki madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: OOP ka dhancha scalability (barhne ki salahiyat) aur adaptability (dhalne ki salahiyat) ki madad karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The structure of OOP supports scalability and adaptability in software development.

blocks.prompt:
10 OOP improves collaboration among programmers by:
(OOP programmers ke darmiyan mil kar kaam (collaboration) ko kaise behtar banata hai?)

options.text: team se saara code chhupa kar
code ko samajh mein aane wala aur munazzam bana kar
har program ko aik lamba block bana kar

blocks.explanation: OOP code ko zyada samajh mein aane wala aur munazzam bana kar collaboration behtar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It also improves collaboration by making code more understandable and organized.

blocks.prompt:
11 According to the Tidbit, OOP helps programmers think in terms of:
(Tidbit ke mutabiq OOP programmers ko kis andaz mein sochne mein madad deta hai?)

options.text: haqeeqi cheezein, jaise students ya cars

blocks.explanation: Tidbit: OOP programmers ko haqeeqi cheezon, jaise students ya cars, ke andaz mein sochne deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Object-Oriented Programming helps programmers think in terms of real-life objects, like students or cars

blocks.prompt:
12 Modularity means:
(Modularity ka matlab kya hai?)

options.text: poora program aik function mein likhna
aik hi code bar bar copy karna
program ko chhote hisson mein baantna jo alag banaye aur sambhale ja sakein

blocks.explanation: Summary: modularity ka matlab program ko chhote, qabil-e-intezam hisson mein baantna hai taake har hissa alag banaya aur sambhala ja sake.

book_ref.quote: Modularity means dividing a program into smaller, manageable parts so that each part can be developed and maintained separately.

blocks.prompt:
13 Which of the following is NOT a core concept of OOP named in Section 3.2?
(In mein se kaun si cheez Section 3.2 mein batayi gayi OOP ki bunyadi concept NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bunyadi concepts: classes aur objects, encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism.

book_ref.quote: These concepts include classes and objects, encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.

blocks.prompt:
14 If the map (blueprint) of a house is a class, then a house actually built from that map is:
(Agar ghar ka naqsha (blueprint) class hai to us naqshe se bana asal ghar kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Class naqshe (blueprint) jaisi hai aur object us naqshe se bani asal cheez hai.

book_ref.quote: A class is like a blueprint, while an object is the real thing created from that blueprint.

blocks.prompt:
15 In a class, the actions of an entity are written as:
(Class mein kisi entity ke actions (kaam) kis shakal mein likhe jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Class entity ki properties (attributes) aur actions (methods) ko define karti hai.

book_ref.quote: A class is a blueprint or template that defines the properties (attributes) and actions (methods) of an entity.

blocks.prompt:
16 In a class, the properties of an entity are also called:
(Class mein kisi entity ki properties ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Class mein properties ko attributes aur actions ko methods kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: A class is a blueprint or template that defines the properties (attributes) and actions (methods) of an entity.

blocks.prompt:
17 An instance of a class that holds actual values for its attributes is called:
(Class ka woh instance jo apne attributes ki asal values rakhta hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Object class ka instance (namoona) hai jo apne attributes ki asal values rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: An object is an instance of a class that holds actual values for its attributes

blocks.prompt:
18 In the book's Student class, which method sets the name automatically when an object is created?
(Book ki Student class mein kaun sa method object bante hi name set karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Student misal mein __init__ object bante waqt name set karta hai; display() use print karta hai.

book_ref.quote: __init__ → sets the name when an object is created

blocks.prompt:
19 What is the output of the following program?

class Book:
    def __init__(self, title, pages):
        self.title = title
        self.pages = pages

    def info(self):
        print(self.title, self.pages)

b1 = Book("Python", 120)
b2 = Book("Maths", 90)
b2.info()
(Neeche diye gaye program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Har object ka apna data hota hai. info() b2 par call hua, is liye b2 ka title aur pages space ke saath print hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Each object has its own data (Ali, Ahmed)

blocks.prompt:
20 What is the output of the following program?

class Counter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.count = 0

    def add(self):
        self.count += 1

c1 = Counter()
c2 = Counter()
c1.add()
c1.add()
c2.add()
print(c1.count, c2.count)
(Neeche diye gaye program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: c1 aur c2 alag objects hain, har aik ka apna count hai. c1 par add() do baar aur c2 par aik baar chala.

book_ref.quote: Using classes and objects helps organize data and related functionality together, making programs more structured.

blocks.prompt:
21 Inside an instance method, the parameter self refers to:
(Instance method ke andar self parameter kis cheez ki taraf ishara karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: self mojooda object ka reference (hawala) hai jo instance methods ko khud ba khud milta hai.

book_ref.quote: self is the reference to the current object, passed automatically to instance methods.

blocks.prompt:
22 In encapsulation, data and methods are bundled into a single unit called a:
(Encapsulation mein data aur methods ko aik unit mein band kiya jata hai. Woh unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Encapsulation data (variables) aur methods (functions) ko aik unit (class) mein band karti aur data tak seedhi rasai rokti hai.

book_ref.quote: bundle data (variables) and methods (functions) into a single unit (class) and restrict direct access to the data

blocks.prompt:
23 Unlike Java or C++, Python signals how class data should be accessed by using:
(Java ya C++ ke bar-aks Python class data tak rasai ka tareeqa kis cheez se batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Python mein sakht private ya protected keywords nahin; yeh naming conventions (naam rakhne ke riwaj) se batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Unlike languages like Java or C++, Python does not have strict

blocks.prompt:
24 According to the Tidbit on encapsulation, data should be:
(Encapsulation ke Tidbit ke mutabiq data ke saath kya karna chahiye?)

options.text: sab classes ke liye public ho
chhupaya jaye aur methods se rasai control ho

blocks.explanation: Tidbit: data chhupayen aur methods ke zariye rasai control karein.

book_ref.quote: Hide the data and control access using methods.

blocks.prompt:
25 Which of the following is NOT a reason why encapsulation is important?
(In mein se kaun si baat encapsulation ki ahmiyat ki wajah NAHIN hai?)

options.text: Data ko ghair-zaroori rasai se bachati hai
Control ke saath tabdeeli deti hai
Har code data ko seedha badal sake

blocks.explanation: Encapsulation data ko ghair-zaroori rasai se bachati, security barhati, code aasan banati aur control ke saath tabdeeli deti hai; seedhi tabdeeli rokti hai.

book_ref.quote: Protects data from unwanted access

blocks.prompt:
26 In the chapter's bank-account example of encapsulation, the hidden balance can be used only through:
(Chapter ki bank account wali misal mein chhupa hua balance sirf kin ke zariye istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Balance chhupa hai; sirf deposit() aur withdraw() se istemal hota hai. Seedha badal nahin sakte; yahi encapsulation hai.

book_ref.quote: You cannot directly change the balance; this is encapsulation.

blocks.prompt:
27 If no underscore is used, a member such as self.name in a Python class is:
(Agar koi underscore na ho to Python class ka member, jaise self.name, kis qism ka hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Public members har jagah se mil sakte hain; Python mein default se sab members public hote hain (self.attribute_name).

book_ref.quote: By default, all members in Python are public

blocks.prompt:
28 An attribute written as self._marks (one underscore) is a:
(self._marks (aik underscore) kis qism ka attribute hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik underscore (self._attribute_name) protected member ki nishani hai jo class aur us ki subclasses ke liye hai.

book_ref.quote: Syntax: self._attribute_name (single underscore)

blocks.prompt:
29 An attribute written as self.__pin (two underscores) is a:
(self.__pin (do underscores) kis qism ka attribute hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do underscores (self.__attribute_name) private member ki nishani hai jise class ke bahar se aasani se nahin chhua ja sakta.

book_ref.quote: Syntax: self.__attribute_name (double underscore)

blocks.prompt:
30 The mechanism Python uses to change the internal name of a private variable to prevent accidental access is called:
(Private variable ka andaruni naam badal kar ittefaqi rasai rokne wala Python ka tareeqa kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Python name mangling se private variable ka andaruni naam badal deta hai taake ittefaqi rasai na ho.

book_ref.quote: Python uses a mechanism called Name Mangling to change the internal name of the variable to prevent accidental access.

blocks.prompt:
31 A protected member (single underscore) in Python is:
(Python mein protected member (aik underscore) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Protected member aik riwaj (convention) hai, pabandi nahin; yeh doosre developers ko batata hai ke bahar se istemal na karein.

book_ref.quote: It is a convention (not a restriction) to signal to other developers that the member should not be accessed from outside.

blocks.prompt:
32 Which variable name correctly marks a private variable in Python?
(Python mein kaun sa variable naam sahi taur par private variable ko zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Private member ke shuru mein do underscores hote hain: __private_variable. Aik underscore protected hai (Figure 3.2 ki book correction).

book_ref.quote: a private member has two underscores

blocks.explanation: 800 - 300 ke baad 500 bachte hain. Doosra spend(600) 500 se zyada hai, is liye Not enough money print hota hai aur 500 hi rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: These are highly restricted and cannot be easily accessed from outside the class.

blocks.prompt:
34 What happens when this program runs?

class Wallet:
    def __init__(self, amount):
        self.__amount = amount

w = Wallet(800)
print(w.__amount)
(Yeh program chalane par kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: __amount private hai; name mangling us ka andaruni naam badal deti hai, is liye class ke bahar se seedhi rasai AttributeError deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Python uses a mechanism called Name Mangling to change the internal name of the variable to prevent accidental access.

blocks.prompt:
35 What is the output of the following program?

class Student:
    def __init__(self):
        self._marks = 75

s = Student()
print(s._marks)
(Neeche diye gaye program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: _marks sirf convention se protected hai, pabandi nahin, is liye Python rasai deta hai aur value print hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: These are intended for internal use within the class and its subclasses.

blocks.prompt:
36 In inheritance, the new class that takes properties and methods from another class is called a:
(Inheritance mein woh nayi class jo doosri class se properties aur methods leti hai, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nayi class subclass kehlati hai; yeh parent class ke features mein izafa ya tabdeeli kar sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: The new class, called a subclass, can add or modify features of the parent class.

blocks.prompt:
37 Inheritance promotes code reuse and reduces:
(Inheritance code ke dobara istemal ko barhati aur kis cheez ko kam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inheritance code reuse barhati aur redundancy (bila zaroorat takrar) kam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Inheritance promotes code reuse and reduces redundancy.

blocks.prompt:
38 With inheritance, a program can be extended:
(Inheritance ke saath program ko kaise barhaya (extend) ja sakta hai?)

options.text: sirf parent class delete kar ke
sirf poori parent class copy kar ke

blocks.explanation: Inheritance maujooda code dobara likhe baghair program ko barhana aasan banati hai.

book_ref.quote: It also makes it easier to extend programs without rewriting existing code.

blocks.prompt:
39 When a child class inherits from exactly one parent class, it is called:
(Jab child class sirf aik parent class se inherit kare to use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Single inheritance tab hai jab child class theek aik parent class se attributes aur methods le.

book_ref.quote: Single inheritance occurs when a child class (subclass) inherits attributes and methods from exactly one parent class (superclass).

blocks.prompt:
40 The most fundamental form of inheritance in Python is:
(Python mein inheritance ki sab se bunyadi shakal kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Single inheritance Python mein inheritance ki sab se bunyadi shakal hai.

book_ref.quote: This is the most fundamental form of inheritance in Python

blocks.prompt:
41 Which header correctly defines a class Car that inherits from Vehicle?
(Kaun sa header class Car ko Vehicle se inherit karte hue sahi define karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Child class mein parent class ka naam brackets mein likha jata hai: class Child(Parent):.

book_ref.quote: It is defined by passing the parent class name in parentheses

blocks.prompt:
42 The class whose properties are inherited is also called the:
(Jis class ki properties inherit hoti hain use aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Parent class ko base class kehte hain; inherit karne wali child class derived class kehlati hai.

book_ref.quote: Parent Class (Base Class): The class whose properties are inherited.

blocks.prompt:
43 Inside an overriding method, the parent's version of the same method can be called with:
(Override karne wale method ke andar usi method ka parent wala version kis se call hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Child class parent ka method override kar sakti hai; parent wala version super() function se call hota hai.

book_ref.quote: You can use the super() function to call the parent

blocks.explanation: Teacher ko Person se __init__ aur greet() milte hain aur woh teach() ka izafa karti hai. print() mein comma se items ke darmiyan aik space aata hai.

book_ref.quote: In this example, the Dog class inherits the basic functionality of an Animal but adds its own specific behavior.

options.text: Eating aur Woof dono print hote hain

blocks.explanation: Child (Dog) parent (Animal) se inherit karti hai, ulta nahin. Animal object ke paas bark() nahin, is liye AttributeError aata hai.

book_ref.quote: The class that inherits from the parent.

blocks.prompt:
46 A Smartphone class that inherits from both a Camera class and a Computer class is an example of:
(Smartphone class jo Camera aur Computer dono classes se inherit kare, kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Multiple inheritance mein aik class aik se zyada parent classes se inherit karti hai, jaise Smartphone, Camera aur Computer se.

book_ref.quote: such as a Smartphone class inheriting from both a Camera and a Computer class

blocks.explanation: Artist, Writer aur Singer dono se inherit karti hai, is liye us ke paas sing(), write() aur apna paint() hai. Methods call ki tarteeb se chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: This enables a child class to combine behaviors from different sources

blocks.prompt:
48 A chain of inheritance like Grandparent → Parent → Child is called:
(Grandparent → Parent → Child jaisi inheritance ki zanjeer kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Multilevel inheritance mein class aik derived class se inherit karti hai aur khandani shajre jaisi zanjeer banti hai.

book_ref.quote: creating a chain of inheritance similar to a family tree (Grandparent → Parent → Child)

blocks.prompt:
49 In multilevel inheritance, the grandchild class has access to the methods and attributes of:
(Multilevel inheritance mein grandchild class kin ke methods aur attributes istemal kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Grandchild class apne parent aur grandparent dono ke tamam methods aur attributes istemal kar sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: class has access to all methods and attributes from both its immediate parent and its grandparent

blocks.prompt:
50 In the book's example, ElectricCar inherits from Car, and Car inherits from Vehicle. The method start_engine() used by an ElectricCar object is defined in:
(Book ki misal mein ElectricCar, Car se aur Car, Vehicle se inherit karti hai. ElectricCar object jo start_engine() istemal karta hai woh kahan define hai?)
blocks.explanation: start_engine() base class Vehicle mein hai aur Car ke zariye ElectricCar tak pohanchta hai; drive() Car mein aur charge() ElectricCar mein hai.

book_ref.quote: In this example, ElectricCar inherits from Car, which in turn inherits from Vehicle.

blocks.explanation: SmartPhone, Phone se aur Phone, Device se inherit karti hai, is liye x browse() ke saath grandparent ka power_on() bhi chala sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Multilevel inheritance in Python occurs when a class inherits from another drived class

blocks.prompt:
52 The word polymorphism means:
(Polymorphism lafz ka matlab kya hai?)

options.text: aik file mein bohat si classes

blocks.explanation: Polymorphism ka matlab hai bohat si shaklein: aik cheez (function ya object) mauqe ke mutabiq mukhtalif kaam kare.

book_ref.quote: It refers to the ability of an entity (like a function or object) to perform different actions based on the context.

blocks.prompt:
53 Technically, polymorphism allows the same method, function or operator to:
(Takneeki taur par polymorphism aik hi method, function ya operator ko kya karne deta hai?)

options.text: program mein sirf aik baar chalna

blocks.explanation: Polymorphism aik hi method, function ya operator ko object ke mutabiq mukhtalif rawayya dene deta hai.

book_ref.quote: allows the same method, function, or operator to behave differently depending on the object it is working with

blocks.prompt:
54 In the chapter's payment-system example, all payment types use processPayment(). For NetBanking this method:
(Chapter ki payment system misal mein sab payment types processPayment() istemal karte hain. NetBanking ke liye yeh method kya karta hai?)

options.text: bank login par le jata hai

blocks.explanation: Sab payment types processPayment() istemal karte hain magar har aik ka kaam alag hai; NetBanking mein yeh bank login par le jata hai. Naam wahi, kaam alag.

book_ref.quote: NetBanking Payment: redirects to bank login

blocks.prompt:
55 What is the output of the following program?

print(3 + 4, "3" + "4")
(Neeche diye gaye program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Aik hi + operator mukhtalif objects ke saath alag kaam karta hai: numbers ko jorta (7) aur strings ko milata ("34") hai.

book_ref.quote: Technically, Polymorphism allows the same method, function, or operator to behave differently

blocks.prompt:
56 The two main types of polymorphism are:
(Polymorphism ki do bari qismein kaun si hain?)
blocks.explanation: Polymorphism ki do bari qismein compile-time aur runtime polymorphism hain.

book_ref.quote: It mainly includes compile-time and runtime polymorphism

blocks.prompt:
57 Compile-time polymorphism is usually achieved through:
(Compile-time polymorphism aam taur par kis ke zariye hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Compile-time polymorphism compilation ke waqt faisla karti hai, aam taur par method ya operator overloading se.

book_ref.quote: usually through method or operator overloading

blocks.prompt:
58 Which statement about Python is correct?
(Python ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Python bilkul Java ki tarah overloading karta hai
Python default arguments ki ijazat nahin deta
Python mukhtalif types ke arguments nahin le sakta
Python signatures par mabni asal method overloading support nahin karta

blocks.explanation: Java ya C++ ke bar-aks Python function signatures par mabni asal method overloading support nahin karta.

book_ref.quote: But python does not support true method overloading based on function signatures

blocks.prompt:
59 Signature-based overloading is unnecessary in Python mainly because:
(Python mein signature par mabni overloading ki zaroorat kyun nahin?)

options.text: Python dynamically typed hai, aik function mukhtalif types le sakta hai
Python sirf aik argument leta hai
Python programs kabhi compile nahin hote

blocks.explanation: Python dynamically typed hai, is liye aik function mukhtalif types ke arguments le sakta hai; overloading ki zaroorat nahin rehti.

book_ref.quote: Because Python is dynamically typed, a single function can accept arguments of different types

blocks.prompt:
60 Which of the following is NOT a way given in the chapter to get overloading-like behavior in Python?
(In mein se kaun sa tareeqa Python mein overloading jaisa rawayya hasil karne ka chapter mein bataya gaya NAHIN?)

options.text: Aik naam ke do methods alag parameters ke saath likhna

blocks.explanation: Default arguments, variable-length arguments (*args, **kwargs) ya function ke andar conditions se yeh rawayya milta hai, asal signature overloading se nahin.

book_ref.quote: Instead, similar behavior can be achieved using default arguments, variable-length arguments (*args, **kwargs), or conditional logic inside the function.

blocks.explanation: add(5) mein b = 0, nateeja 5. add(2, 3, 4, 1) mein 4 aur 1 *args mein jate hain: 2 + 3 + 4 + 1 = 10.

book_ref.quote: The multiply() method works with different numbers of inputs, mimicking compile-time polymorphism.

blocks.explanation: Koi argument na ho to default a = 0 aur b = 0 lagte hain aur *args khali hai, is liye 0 wapas aata hai.

book_ref.quote: This code demonstrates method overloading using default and variable-length arguments.

blocks.prompt:
63 Runtime polymorphism happens through:
(Runtime polymorphism kis ke zariye hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Runtime polymorphism method overriding se hoti hai: child class parent ke method ka apna version deti hai.

book_ref.quote: This happens through Method Overriding a child class provides its own version of a method already defined in the parent class.

blocks.prompt:
64 In runtime polymorphism, which version of a method runs is decided:
(Runtime polymorphism mein method ka kaun sa version chalega, yeh kab tay hota hai?)

options.text: program chalte waqt, call karne wale object ke mutabiq

blocks.explanation: Runtime polymorphism mein program chalte waqt call karne wale object ke mutabiq method ka rawayya tay hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Runtime polymorphism means that the behavior of a method is decided while program is running, based on the object calling it.

blocks.explanation: area() Square (3 x 3 = 9) aur Rectangle (2 x 5 = 10) mein override hai; Shape apna version (0) rakhti hai. Har object ki class ke mutabiq sahi method chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: At runtime, the correct method is called based on object

blocks.explanation: Cow ne sound() override kiya; us ke andar super().sound() pehle parent wala version (Some sound) chalata hai, phir Moo print hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Method Overriding: A child class can provide a specific implementation of a method that is already provided by its parent.

blocks.prompt:
67 Using the same method or operation in different ways depending on the object is called:
(Object ke mutabiq aik hi method ya operation ko mukhtalif tareeqon se istemal karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Summary: polymorphism aik hi method ya operation ko object ke mutabiq alag tareeqe se istemal karna hai.

book_ref.quote: Polymorphism means using the same method or operation in different ways depending on the object.
